title: Hosea Redeems His Wife

questions.question: The Lord told Hosea to go again and love a woman who is loved by another man and is a what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 3:1 (ESV): "Go again, love a woman who is loved by another man and is an adulteress,"

questions.question: Just as the Lord loves the children of Israel, even though they turn to other gods and love cakes of what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 3:1 (ESV): "even as the Lord loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods and love cakes of raisins."

questions.question: How much silver did Hosea buy her for?
questions.explanation: Hosea 3:2 (ESV): "So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver"

questions.question: Hosea told her she must dwell as his for how long?
questions.explanation: Hosea 3:3 (ESV): "You must dwell as mine for many days."

questions.question: For the children of Israel shall dwell many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or what?
Besides silver, what else did Hosea pay to buy her?
options: A homer and a lethech of barley
questions.correctAnswer: A homer and a lethech of barley
questions.explanation: Hosea 3:2 (ESV): "and a homer and a lethech of barley."

questions.question: What four things are listed as being without, besides king, prince, sacrifice, and pillar?
Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek whom?
options: The Lord their God and David their king
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord their God and David their king
questions.explanation: Hosea 3:5 (ESV): "Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the Lord their God, and David their king,"

questions.question: They shall come in fear to the Lord and to his goodness in the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 3:5 (ESV): "and they shall come in fear to the Lord and to his goodness in the latter days."

questions.question: Hosea said to her, "You shall not play the..."?
questions.explanation: Hosea 3:3 (ESV): "You shall not play the whore,"

questions.question: Hosea said, "so will I also be to..."?
questions.explanation: Hosea 3:3 (ESV): "so will I also be to you."

questions.question: The phrase "David their king" is understood to refer to whom prophetically?
questions.explanation: Prophetic interpretation context, viewing David as a type of the Messiah.

questions.question: The condition of Israel described in verse 4 (without king, sacrifice, etc.) describes a period of what?
options: Exile and loss of national and religious identity
questions.correctAnswer: Exile and loss of national and religious identity
questions.explanation: Interpreting the list of "withouts" as a state of deprivation and exile.

questions.question: Who commanded Hosea to "Go again"?
questions.explanation: Hosea 3:1 (ESV): "And the Lord said to me, 'Go again...'"

key_verse_text: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the Lord their God, and David their king, and they shall come in fear to the Lord and to his goodness in the latter days.
